notes: The supplied *it had been* rides with πρόσωπον under rule 68, the comparative clause expressing no subject at all, so the predicate noun carries both the supplied subject and the copula; the supplied *the* is a rule 51 helper on the anarthrous noun.

ἀτενίσαντες heads on *fastening*, the word carrying the lexeme's own fixity; *eyes* is the supplied completion and *their* a rule 7 possessive, no other source token standing to take either. The competing head on *eyes* is named in the unit.
